## F5. Best Combined Configuration (Scoring + Risk)

```{r}
#| label: f5-best-combined

# =============================================================================
# F5. Extract Best Combined Configuration
# =============================================================================

best_risk_row     <- sweep_f3[1, ]
best_risk_variant <- best_risk_row$variant

best_pen <- compute_risk_penalty(
  df_risk,
  best_risk_row$alpha_y, best_risk_row$alpha_r, best_risk_row$alpha_L,
  best_risk_row$beta, variant = best_risk_variant
)

df_combined_best <- df_risk |>
  mutate(
    risk_penalty            = best_pen,
    adoption_score_combined = adoption_score -
                              best_risk_row$w_R * risk_penalty,
    basal_weighted          = total_production * weight_calibrated
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(adoption_score_combined))

traj_f5 <- trajectory_binary(df_combined_best)
mad_f5  <- mad_vs_anchors(traj_f5)
```

---

# Phase G: Continuous Adoption Sweeps

The continuous adoption model assigns each farmer to one of three behavioural profiles based on white-maize land area: small (S, near-binary adoption), medium (M, sigmoid adoption), and large (L, gradual adoption). The per-farmer conversion ratio `r_i(p)` depends on the farmer's profile and on the farmer's entry point `p_entry` in the global ranking. Three design axes are explored sequentially, with each axis inheriting the best configuration from the previous one: floor values (F), steepness coefficients (G), and profile cutoffs (H).

Phase G inherits the combined scoring + risk configuration from Phase F.

## G1. Setup p_entry and Initial Profile Assignment

The per-farmer entry point is computed from the cumulative basal production under the combined ranking. The initial profile assignment uses a reference cutoff scheme based on empirical land percentiles; the cutoff sweep in G4 explores a refined grid that subsumes this reference.

```{r}
#| label: g1-p-entry-setup

# =============================================================================
# G1. Compute p_entry and Initial Profile Assignment
# =============================================================================

total_basal_combined <- sum(df_combined_best$basal_weighted, na.rm = TRUE)

df_with_entry <- df_combined_best |>
  mutate(
    cum_basal = cumsum(basal_weighted),
    p_entry   = pmax(0, (cum_basal - basal_weighted) / total_basal_combined)
  )

# Reference cutoffs from empirical land percentiles (used during G2 floor sweep)
land_pcts_weighted <- function(df, qs) {
  o <- order(df$land_wtcorn)
  L <- df$land_wtcorn[o]
  W <- df$weight_calibrated[o]
  cw <- cumsum(W) / sum(W)
  map_dbl(qs, ~ L[which.min(abs(cw - .x))])
}

land_p_ref <- land_pcts_weighted(df_with_entry, c(0.50, 0.85))
cuts_ref   <- c(S_M = land_p_ref[1], M_L = land_p_ref[2])

df_with_entry <- df_with_entry |>
  mutate(
    profile = case_when(
      land_wtcorn <  cuts_ref[["S_M"]] ~ "S",
      land_wtcorn <  cuts_ref[["M_L"]] ~ "M",
      TRUE                              ~ "L"
    )
  )
```

## G2. Sweep — Floor Values per Profile

The floor values determine the conversion ratio at the moment a farmer enters the ranking. They are explored first because the floor values exert the strongest influence on the cohort land-trimmed metric. The reference steepness configuration (`k_S = 12, k_M = 8, k_L = 4`) and the reference cutoff scheme are held during this sweep.

```{r}
#| label: g2-sweep-floors

# =============================================================================
# G2. Sweep - Floor Values per Profile
# =============================================================================

floor_grid <- expand_grid(
  floor_S = c(0.85, 0.95),
  floor_M = c(0.40, 0.50),
  floor_L = c(0.02, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20)
)

set.seed(789)

sweep_g2 <- local({

  df_entry_slim <- df_with_entry |>
    select(p_entry, profile, weight_calibrated, segment_final, land_wtcorn)

  physical_cores <- parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE)
  n_daemons      <- min(nrow(floor_grid), max(1, physical_cores - 3))
  mirai_profile  <- "sweep_g2_floors"

  mirai::daemons(n_daemons, .compute = mirai_profile)
  on.exit(mirai::daemons(0, .compute = mirai_profile), add = TRUE)

  mirai::everywhere(
    {
      suppressPackageStartupMessages({
        library(dplyr)
        library(purrr)
        library(Hmisc)
      })
      if (requireNamespace("RhpcBLASctl", quietly = TRUE)) {
        RhpcBLASctl::blas_set_num_threads(1)
        RhpcBLASctl::omp_set_num_threads(1)
      }
    },
    .compute = mirai_profile
  )

  cells <- pmap(floor_grid, function(floor_S, floor_M, floor_L) {
    list(floor_S = floor_S, floor_M = floor_M, floor_L = floor_L)
  })

  m <- mirai::mirai_map(
    .x = cells,
    .f = function(cell, df_scored, p_grid,
                  anchors_farmers, anchors_land, anchor_weights) {

      trimmed_mean_p5p95 <- function(values, weights) {
        ok <- !is.na(values) & !is.na(weights) & weights > 0
        if (sum(ok) < 2) return(NA_real_)
        v <- values[ok]; w <- weights[ok]
        q <- Hmisc::wtd.quantile(v, weights = w, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))
        keep <- v >= q[[1]] & v <= q[[2]]
        if (!any(keep)) return(NA_real_)
        sum(v[keep] * w[keep]) / sum(w[keep])
      }

      sigmoid_curve <- function(p, p_entry, floor_val, k) {
        u <- (p - p_entry) / pmax(1 - p_entry, 1e-6)
        raw  <- 1 / (1 + exp(-k * (u - 0.5)))
        raw0 <- 1 / (1 + exp(-k * (0 - 0.5)))
        raw1 <- 1 / (1 + exp(-k * (1 - 0.5)))
        scaled <- floor_val + (1 - floor_val) * (raw - raw0) / (raw1 - raw0)
        if_else(p < p_entry, 0, pmin(1, pmax(floor_val, scaled)))
      }

      apply_curve <- function(p, p_entry, profile,
                              floor_S_v, floor_M_v, floor_L_v,
                              k_S_v, k_M_v, k_L_v) {
        case_when(
          profile == "S" ~ sigmoid_curve(p, p_entry, floor_S_v, k_S_v),
          profile == "M" ~ sigmoid_curve(p, p_entry, floor_M_v, k_M_v),
          profile == "L" ~ sigmoid_curve(p, p_entry, floor_L_v, k_L_v)
        )
      }

      trajectory_continuous <- function(df_sc, p_grid_use,
                                        k_S_use, k_M_use, k_L_use,
                                        floor_S_use, floor_M_use, floor_L_use) {
        map_dfr(p_grid_use, function(pv) {
          r_i <- apply_curve(pv, df_sc$p_entry, df_sc$profile,
                             floor_S_v = floor_S_use,
                             floor_M_v = floor_M_use,
                             floor_L_v = floor_L_use,
                             k_S_v = k_S_use, k_M_v = k_M_use, k_L_v = k_L_use)
          admitted_idx <- which(r_i > 0)
          if (length(admitted_idx) == 0) {
            return(tibble(p = pv,
                          N_OPV = 0, N_Low = 0, N_Mid = 0, N_High = 0,
                          land_overall_mz = NA_real_))
          }
          w_eff <- df_sc$weight_calibrated[admitted_idx] *
                   r_i[admitted_idx]
          seg   <- df_sc$segment_final[admitted_idx]
          land  <- df_sc$land_wtcorn[admitted_idx]
          land_biofortified <- land * r_i[admitted_idx]
          w_pop <- df_sc$weight_calibrated[admitted_idx]
          N_per_seg <- function(s) sum(w_eff[seg == s])
          tibble(p = pv,
                 N_OPV = N_per_seg("OPV/Criollo"),
                 N_Low = N_per_seg("Low"),
                 N_Mid = N_per_seg("Mid"),
                 N_High = N_per_seg("High"),
                 land_overall_mz = trimmed_mean_p5p95(land_biofortified,
                                                     w_pop))
        })
      }

      mad_vs_anchors_local <- function(traj) {
        key <- function(x) round(x * 1000)
        traj_keyed <- traj |>
          mutate(p_key = key(p)) |>
          select(p_key, N_OPV, N_Low, N_Mid, N_High, land_overall_mz)
        anch_f_keyed <- anchors_farmers |>
          mutate(p_key = key(p_anchor)) |>
          select(p_key, N_OPV, N_Low, N_Mid, N_High) |>
          rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_anc"), -p_key)
        anch_l_keyed <- anchors_land |>
          mutate(p_key = key(p_anchor)) |>
          select(p_key, land_overall_mz) |>
          rename(land_overall_mz_anc = land_overall_mz)
        w_keyed <- anchor_weights |>
          mutate(p_key = key(p_anchor)) |>
          select(p_key, w_p)
        joined <- anch_f_keyed |>
          inner_join(anch_l_keyed, by = "p_key") |>
          inner_join(w_keyed,      by = "p_key") |>
          inner_join(traj_keyed,   by = "p_key") |>
          arrange(p_key)
        dev_seg <- abs(joined$N_OPV  - joined$N_OPV_anc)  / (joined$N_OPV_anc  + 1) +
                   abs(joined$N_Low  - joined$N_Low_anc)  / (joined$N_Low_anc  + 1) +
                   abs(joined$N_Mid  - joined$N_Mid_anc)  / (joined$N_Mid_anc  + 1) +
                   abs(joined$N_High - joined$N_High_anc) / (joined$N_High_anc + 1)
        mad_farmers <- sum(joined$w_p * dev_seg, na.rm = TRUE)
        dev_land <- abs(joined$land_overall_mz - joined$land_overall_mz_anc) /
                    (joined$land_overall_mz_anc + 0.01)
        mad_land <- sum(joined$w_p * dev_land, na.rm = TRUE)
        list(mad_farmers = mad_farmers, mad_land = mad_land,
             mad_global = mad_farmers / 4 + mad_land)
      }

      traj <- trajectory_continuous(
        df_scored, p_grid,
        k_S_use = 12, k_M_use = 8, k_L_use = 4,
        floor_S_use = cell$floor_S,
        floor_M_use = cell$floor_M,
        floor_L_use = cell$floor_L
      )
      res <- mad_vs_anchors_local(traj)
      tibble(
        floor_S     = cell$floor_S,
        floor_M     = cell$floor_M,
        floor_L     = cell$floor_L,
        mad_farmers = res$mad_farmers,
        mad_land    = res$mad_land,
        mad_global  = res$mad_global
      )
    },
    .args = list(
      df_scored       = df_entry_slim,
      p_grid          = p_grid,
      anchors_farmers = anchors_farmers,
      anchors_land    = anchors_land,
      anchor_weights  = anchor_weights
    ),
    .compute = mirai_profile
  )

  results <- m[]
  errors  <- which(vapply(results, inherits, logical(1), "errorValue"))
  if (length(errors) > 0) {
    stop(sprintf("G2: %d/%d tasks failed. First error (task %d): %s",
                 length(errors), length(results), errors[1],
                 as.character(results[[errors[1]]])))
  }

  results |>
    bind_rows() |>
    arrange(mad_global)
})
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-g2-floors
#| tbl-cap: "Sensitivity to Floor Values per Profile"

export(
  sweep_g2,
  here("01_data", "02_processed", "web_resources",
       paste0(file_prefix, "_tbl_g2_floor_sweep.rds"))
)

sweep_g2 |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title    = "Sensitivity to floor values per profile",
    subtitle = "Steepness coefficients and cutoffs held at reference; ordered by global MAD"
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    floor_S     = "floor_S",
    floor_M     = "floor_M",
    floor_L     = "floor_L",
    mad_farmers = "MAD farmers",
    mad_land    = "MAD land (mz)",
    mad_global  = "MAD global"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(floor_S, floor_M, floor_L), decimals = 2) |>
  fmt_number(columns = mad_farmers, decimals = 3) |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(mad_land, mad_global), decimals = 3) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.size          = px(11),
    heading.title.font.size  = px(14)
  )

# Capture the best floors
best_floors <- sweep_g2[1, ]
```

## G3. Sweep — Steepness Coefficients per Profile

Holding the best floor values from G2 and the reference cutoff scheme, the steepness coefficients are explored. The grid for `k_L` extends toward lower values so the optimum can be located in the interior of the grid.

```{r}
#| label: g3-sweep-steepness

# =============================================================================
# G3. Sweep - Steepness Coefficients
# =============================================================================

steepness_grid <- expand_grid(
  k_S = c(8, 12, 16),
  k_M = c(4, 8),
  k_L = c(0.5, 1, 1.5, 2)
)

set.seed(789)

sweep_g3 <- local({

  df_entry_slim <- df_with_entry |>
    select(p_entry, profile, weight_calibrated, segment_final, land_wtcorn)

  physical_cores <- parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE)
  n_daemons      <- min(nrow(steepness_grid), max(1, physical_cores - 3))
  mirai_profile  <- "sweep_g3_steepness"

  mirai::daemons(n_daemons, .compute = mirai_profile)
  on.exit(mirai::daemons(0, .compute = mirai_profile), add = TRUE)

  mirai::everywhere(
    {
      suppressPackageStartupMessages({
        library(dplyr)
        library(purrr)
        library(Hmisc)
      })
      if (requireNamespace("RhpcBLASctl", quietly = TRUE)) {
        RhpcBLASctl::blas_set_num_threads(1)
        RhpcBLASctl::omp_set_num_threads(1)
      }
    },
    .compute = mirai_profile
  )

  cells <- pmap(steepness_grid, function(k_S, k_M, k_L) {
    list(k_S = k_S, k_M = k_M, k_L = k_L)
  })

  m <- mirai::mirai_map(
    .x = cells,
    .f = function(cell, df_scored, p_grid, floor_S, floor_M, floor_L,
                  anchors_farmers, anchors_land, anchor_weights) {

      trimmed_mean_p5p95 <- function(values, weights) {
        ok <- !is.na(values) & !is.na(weights) & weights > 0
        if (sum(ok) < 2) return(NA_real_)
        v <- values[ok]; w <- weights[ok]
        q <- Hmisc::wtd.quantile(v, weights = w, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))
        keep <- v >= q[[1]] & v <= q[[2]]
        if (!any(keep)) return(NA_real_)
        sum(v[keep] * w[keep]) / sum(w[keep])
      }

      sigmoid_curve <- function(p, p_entry, floor_val, k) {
        u <- (p - p_entry) / pmax(1 - p_entry, 1e-6)
        raw  <- 1 / (1 + exp(-k * (u - 0.5)))
        raw0 <- 1 / (1 + exp(-k * (0 - 0.5)))
        raw1 <- 1 / (1 + exp(-k * (1 - 0.5)))
        scaled <- floor_val + (1 - floor_val) * (raw - raw0) / (raw1 - raw0)
        if_else(p < p_entry, 0, pmin(1, pmax(floor_val, scaled)))
      }

      apply_curve <- function(p, p_entry, profile,
                              floor_S_v, floor_M_v, floor_L_v,
                              k_S_v, k_M_v, k_L_v) {
        case_when(
          profile == "S" ~ sigmoid_curve(p, p_entry, floor_S_v, k_S_v),
          profile == "M" ~ sigmoid_curve(p, p_entry, floor_M_v, k_M_v),
          profile == "L" ~ sigmoid_curve(p, p_entry, floor_L_v, k_L_v)
        )
      }

      trajectory_continuous <- function(df_sc, p_grid_use,
                                        k_S_use, k_M_use, k_L_use,
                                        floor_S_use, floor_M_use, floor_L_use) {
        map_dfr(p_grid_use, function(pv) {
          r_i <- apply_curve(pv, df_sc$p_entry, df_sc$profile,
                             floor_S_v = floor_S_use,
                             floor_M_v = floor_M_use,
                             floor_L_v = floor_L_use,
                             k_S_v = k_S_use, k_M_v = k_M_use, k_L_v = k_L_use)
          admitted_idx <- which(r_i > 0)
          if (length(admitted_idx) == 0) {
            return(tibble(p = pv,
                          N_OPV = 0, N_Low = 0, N_Mid = 0, N_High = 0,
                          land_overall_mz = NA_real_))
          }
          w_eff <- df_sc$weight_calibrated[admitted_idx] *
                   r_i[admitted_idx]
          seg   <- df_sc$segment_final[admitted_idx]
          land  <- df_sc$land_wtcorn[admitted_idx]
          land_biofortified <- land * r_i[admitted_idx]
          w_pop <- df_sc$weight_calibrated[admitted_idx]
          N_per_seg <- function(s) sum(w_eff[seg == s])
          tibble(p = pv,
                 N_OPV = N_per_seg("OPV/Criollo"),
                 N_Low = N_per_seg("Low"),
                 N_Mid = N_per_seg("Mid"),
                 N_High = N_per_seg("High"),
                 land_overall_mz = trimmed_mean_p5p95(land_biofortified,
                                                     w_pop))
        })
      }

      mad_vs_anchors_local <- function(traj) {
        key <- function(x) round(x * 1000)
        traj_keyed <- traj |>
          mutate(p_key = key(p)) |>
          select(p_key, N_OPV, N_Low, N_Mid, N_High, land_overall_mz)
        anch_f_keyed <- anchors_farmers |>
          mutate(p_key = key(p_anchor)) |>
          select(p_key, N_OPV, N_Low, N_Mid, N_High) |>
          rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_anc"), -p_key)
        anch_l_keyed <- anchors_land |>
          mutate(p_key = key(p_anchor)) |>
          select(p_key, land_overall_mz) |>
          rename(land_overall_mz_anc = land_overall_mz)
        w_keyed <- anchor_weights |>
          mutate(p_key = key(p_anchor)) |>
          select(p_key, w_p)
        joined <- anch_f_keyed |>
          inner_join(anch_l_keyed, by = "p_key") |>
          inner_join(w_keyed,      by = "p_key") |>
          inner_join(traj_keyed,   by = "p_key") |>
          arrange(p_key)
        dev_seg <- abs(joined$N_OPV  - joined$N_OPV_anc)  / (joined$N_OPV_anc  + 1) +
                   abs(joined$N_Low  - joined$N_Low_anc)  / (joined$N_Low_anc  + 1) +
                   abs(joined$N_Mid  - joined$N_Mid_anc)  / (joined$N_Mid_anc  + 1) +
                   abs(joined$N_High - joined$N_High_anc) / (joined$N_High_anc + 1)
        mad_farmers <- sum(joined$w_p * dev_seg, na.rm = TRUE)
        dev_land <- abs(joined$land_overall_mz - joined$land_overall_mz_anc) /
                    (joined$land_overall_mz_anc + 0.01)
        mad_land <- sum(joined$w_p * dev_land, na.rm = TRUE)
        list(mad_farmers = mad_farmers, mad_land = mad_land,
             mad_global = mad_farmers / 4 + mad_land)
      }

      traj <- trajectory_continuous(
        df_scored, p_grid,
        k_S_use = cell$k_S, k_M_use = cell$k_M, k_L_use = cell$k_L,
        floor_S_use = floor_S,
        floor_M_use = floor_M,
        floor_L_use = floor_L
      )
      res <- mad_vs_anchors_local(traj)
      tibble(
        k_S         = cell$k_S,
        k_M         = cell$k_M,
        k_L         = cell$k_L,
        mad_farmers = res$mad_farmers,
        mad_land    = res$mad_land,
        mad_global  = res$mad_global
      )
    },
    .args = list(
      df_scored       = df_entry_slim,
      p_grid          = p_grid,
      floor_S         = best_floors$floor_S,
      floor_M         = best_floors$floor_M,
      floor_L         = best_floors$floor_L,
      anchors_farmers = anchors_farmers,
      anchors_land    = anchors_land,
      anchor_weights  = anchor_weights
    ),
    .compute = mirai_profile
  )

  results <- m[]
  errors  <- which(vapply(results, inherits, logical(1), "errorValue"))
  if (length(errors) > 0) {
    stop(sprintf("G3: %d/%d tasks failed. First error (task %d): %s",
                 length(errors), length(results), errors[1],
                 as.character(results[[errors[1]]])))
  }

  results |>
    bind_rows() |>
    arrange(mad_global)
})
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-g3-steepness
#| tbl-cap: "Sensitivity to Steepness Coefficients per Profile"

export(
  sweep_g3,
  here("01_data", "02_processed", "web_resources",
       paste0(file_prefix, "_tbl_g3_steepness_sweep.rds"))
)

sweep_g3 |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title    = "Sensitivity to steepness coefficients per profile",
    subtitle = paste0("Floors from G2 fixed (floor_S=", best_floors$floor_S,
                      ", floor_M=", best_floors$floor_M,
                      ", floor_L=", best_floors$floor_L,
                      "); ordered by global MAD")
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    k_S         = "k_S",
    k_M         = "k_M",
    k_L         = "k_L",
    mad_farmers = "MAD farmers",
    mad_land    = "MAD land (mz)",
    mad_global  = "MAD global"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(k_S, k_M, k_L), decimals = 2) |>
  fmt_number(columns = mad_farmers, decimals = 3) |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(mad_land, mad_global), decimals = 3) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.size          = px(11),
    heading.title.font.size  = px(14)
  )

# Capture the best steepness
best_steep <- sweep_g3[1, ]
```

## G4. Sweep — Profile Cutoff Sensitivity

Holding the best floor values from G2 and the best steepness coefficients from G3, a refined grid of cutoffs is explored. The grid samples `cut_S/M \u2208 {1.0, 1.25, 1.5}` and `cut_M/L \u2208 {3, 4, 5, 6, 7}`.

```{r}
#| label: g4-sweep-cutoffs

# =============================================================================
# G4. Sweep - Profile Cutoff Schemes (Refined Grid)
# =============================================================================

cutoffs_grid <- expand_grid(
  cut_S_M = c(1.0, 1.25, 1.5),
  cut_M_L = c(3, 4, 5, 6, 7)
) |>
  filter(cut_S_M < cut_M_L)

set.seed(789)

sweep_g4 <- local({

  df_entry_slim <- df_with_entry |>
    select(p_entry, profile, weight_calibrated, segment_final, land_wtcorn)

  physical_cores <- parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE)
  n_daemons      <- min(nrow(cutoffs_grid), max(1, physical_cores - 3))
  mirai_profile  <- "sweep_g4_cutoffs"

  mirai::daemons(n_daemons, .compute = mirai_profile)
  on.exit(mirai::daemons(0, .compute = mirai_profile), add = TRUE)

  mirai::everywhere(
    {
      suppressPackageStartupMessages({
        library(dplyr)
        library(purrr)
        library(Hmisc)
      })
      if (requireNamespace("RhpcBLASctl", quietly = TRUE)) {
        RhpcBLASctl::blas_set_num_threads(1)
        RhpcBLASctl::omp_set_num_threads(1)
      }
    },
    .compute = mirai_profile
  )

  cells <- pmap(cutoffs_grid, function(cut_S_M, cut_M_L) {
    list(cut_S_M = cut_S_M, cut_M_L = cut_M_L)
  })

  m <- mirai::mirai_map(
    .x = cells,
    .f = function(cell, df_scored, p_grid,
                  k_S, k_M, k_L, floor_S, floor_M, floor_L,
                  anchors_farmers, anchors_land, anchor_weights) {

      trimmed_mean_p5p95 <- function(values, weights) {
        ok <- !is.na(values) & !is.na(weights) & weights > 0
        if (sum(ok) < 2) return(NA_real_)
        v <- values[ok]; w <- weights[ok]
        q <- Hmisc::wtd.quantile(v, weights = w, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))
        keep <- v >= q[[1]] & v <= q[[2]]
        if (!any(keep)) return(NA_real_)
        sum(v[keep] * w[keep]) / sum(w[keep])
      }

      sigmoid_curve <- function(p, p_entry, floor_val, k) {
        u <- (p - p_entry) / pmax(1 - p_entry, 1e-6)
        raw  <- 1 / (1 + exp(-k * (u - 0.5)))
        raw0 <- 1 / (1 + exp(-k * (0 - 0.5)))
        raw1 <- 1 / (1 + exp(-k * (1 - 0.5)))
        scaled <- floor_val + (1 - floor_val) * (raw - raw0) / (raw1 - raw0)
        if_else(p < p_entry, 0, pmin(1, pmax(floor_val, scaled)))
      }

      apply_curve <- function(p, p_entry, profile,
                              floor_S_v, floor_M_v, floor_L_v,
                              k_S_v, k_M_v, k_L_v) {
        case_when(
          profile == "S" ~ sigmoid_curve(p, p_entry, floor_S_v, k_S_v),
          profile == "M" ~ sigmoid_curve(p, p_entry, floor_M_v, k_M_v),
          profile == "L" ~ sigmoid_curve(p, p_entry, floor_L_v, k_L_v)
        )
      }

      trajectory_continuous <- function(df_sc, p_grid_use,
                                        k_S_use, k_M_use, k_L_use,
                                        floor_S_use, floor_M_use, floor_L_use) {
        map_dfr(p_grid_use, function(pv) {
          r_i <- apply_curve(pv, df_sc$p_entry, df_sc$profile,
                             floor_S_v = floor_S_use,
                             floor_M_v = floor_M_use,
                             floor_L_v = floor_L_use,
                             k_S_v = k_S_use, k_M_v = k_M_use, k_L_v = k_L_use)
          admitted_idx <- which(r_i > 0)
          if (length(admitted_idx) == 0) {
            return(tibble(p = pv,
                          N_OPV = 0, N_Low = 0, N_Mid = 0, N_High = 0,
                          land_overall_mz = NA_real_))
          }
          w_eff <- df_sc$weight_calibrated[admitted_idx] *
                   r_i[admitted_idx]
          seg   <- df_sc$segment_final[admitted_idx]
          land  <- df_sc$land_wtcorn[admitted_idx]
          land_biofortified <- land * r_i[admitted_idx]
          w_pop <- df_sc$weight_calibrated[admitted_idx]
          N_per_seg <- function(s) sum(w_eff[seg == s])
          tibble(p = pv,
                 N_OPV = N_per_seg("OPV/Criollo"),
                 N_Low = N_per_seg("Low"),
                 N_Mid = N_per_seg("Mid"),
                 N_High = N_per_seg("High"),
                 land_overall_mz = trimmed_mean_p5p95(land_biofortified,
                                                     w_pop))
        })
      }

      mad_vs_anchors_local <- function(traj) {
        key <- function(x) round(x * 1000)
        traj_keyed <- traj |>
          mutate(p_key = key(p)) |>
          select(p_key, N_OPV, N_Low, N_Mid, N_High, land_overall_mz)
        anch_f_keyed <- anchors_farmers |>
          mutate(p_key = key(p_anchor)) |>
          select(p_key, N_OPV, N_Low, N_Mid, N_High) |>
          rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_anc"), -p_key)
        anch_l_keyed <- anchors_land |>
          mutate(p_key = key(p_anchor)) |>
          select(p_key, land_overall_mz) |>
          rename(land_overall_mz_anc = land_overall_mz)
        w_keyed <- anchor_weights |>
          mutate(p_key = key(p_anchor)) |>
          select(p_key, w_p)
        joined <- anch_f_keyed |>
          inner_join(anch_l_keyed, by = "p_key") |>
          inner_join(w_keyed,      by = "p_key") |>
          inner_join(traj_keyed,   by = "p_key") |>
          arrange(p_key)
        dev_seg <- abs(joined$N_OPV  - joined$N_OPV_anc)  / (joined$N_OPV_anc  + 1) +
                   abs(joined$N_Low  - joined$N_Low_anc)  / (joined$N_Low_anc  + 1) +
                   abs(joined$N_Mid  - joined$N_Mid_anc)  / (joined$N_Mid_anc  + 1) +
                   abs(joined$N_High - joined$N_High_anc) / (joined$N_High_anc + 1)
        mad_farmers <- sum(joined$w_p * dev_seg, na.rm = TRUE)
        dev_land <- abs(joined$land_overall_mz - joined$land_overall_mz_anc) /
                    (joined$land_overall_mz_anc + 0.01)
        mad_land <- sum(joined$w_p * dev_land, na.rm = TRUE)
        list(mad_farmers = mad_farmers, mad_land = mad_land,
             mad_global = mad_farmers / 4 + mad_land)
      }

      df_local <- df_scored |>
        mutate(
          profile = case_when(
            land_wtcorn <  cell$cut_S_M ~ "S",
            land_wtcorn <  cell$cut_M_L ~ "M",
            TRUE                         ~ "L"
          )
        )
      traj <- trajectory_continuous(
        df_local, p_grid,
        k_S_use = k_S, k_M_use = k_M, k_L_use = k_L,
        floor_S_use = floor_S,
        floor_M_use = floor_M,
        floor_L_use = floor_L
      )
      res <- mad_vs_anchors_local(traj)
      tibble(
        cut_S_M     = cell$cut_S_M,
        cut_M_L     = cell$cut_M_L,
        mad_farmers = res$mad_farmers,
        mad_land    = res$mad_land,
        mad_global  = res$mad_global
      )
    },
    .args = list(
      df_scored       = df_entry_slim,
      p_grid          = p_grid,
      k_S             = best_steep$k_S,
      k_M             = best_steep$k_M,
      k_L             = best_steep$k_L,
      floor_S         = best_floors$floor_S,
      floor_M         = best_floors$floor_M,
      floor_L         = best_floors$floor_L,
      anchors_farmers = anchors_farmers,
      anchors_land    = anchors_land,
      anchor_weights  = anchor_weights
    ),
    .compute = mirai_profile
  )

  results <- m[]
  errors  <- which(vapply(results, inherits, logical(1), "errorValue"))
  if (length(errors) > 0) {
    stop(sprintf("G4: %d/%d tasks failed. First error (task %d): %s",
                 length(errors), length(results), errors[1],
                 as.character(results[[errors[1]]])))
  }

  results |>
    bind_rows() |>
    arrange(mad_global)
})
```

```{r}

  sweep_g4,
  here("01_data", "02_processed", "web_resources",
       paste0(file_prefix, "_tbl_g4_cutoffs_sweep.rds"))
)

sweep_g4 |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title    = "Sensitivity to profile cutoff schemes (refined grid)",
    subtitle = paste0("Floors from G2 and steepness from G3 fixed (k_S=",
                      best_steep$k_S, ", k_M=", best_steep$k_M,
                      ", k_L=", best_steep$k_L, "); ordered by global MAD")
  ) |>

  tab_options(
    table.font.size          = px(11),
    heading.title.font.size  = px(14)
  )

# Capture the best cutoffs
```

---

# Phase H: Integrated Model Evaluation and Export

This phase consolidates the best configuration from all sweeps, evaluates the integrated model against the calibration anchors, displays the final fit summary and the trajectory plot, and exports the consolidated model configuration as a single `.rds` artefact consumed by script 02_06.

## H1. Apply Integrated Model

Apply the full integrated model — best scoring configuration from Phase E, best risk-aversion configuration from Phase F, best continuous-adoption configuration from Phase G — and evaluate the cohort trajectory against the calibration anchors.

```{r}
#| label: h1-apply-integrated

# =============================================================================
# H1. Apply Integrated Model
# =============================================================================

df_integrated <- df_with_entry |>
  mutate(
    profile = case_when(
      land_wtcorn <  best_cuts[["S_M"]] ~ "S",
      land_wtcorn <  best_cuts[["M_L"]] ~ "M",
      TRUE                              ~ "L"
    )
  )

traj_integrated <- trajectory_continuous(
  df_integrated, p_grid,
  k_S_use     = best_steep$k_S,
  k_M_use     = best_steep$k_M,
  k_L_use     = best_steep$k_L,
  floor_S_use = best_floors$floor_S,
  floor_M_use = best_floors$floor_M,
  floor_L_use = best_floors$floor_L
)

mad_integrated <- mad_vs_anchors(traj_integrated)
```

## H2. Integrated Model Calibration Summary

The integrated model's calibration distance against the anchor set is reported in a single summary row. The MAD farmers component aggregates relative per-segment count deviations across the five anchors; the MAD land component aggregates relative biofortified-area deviations; the MAD global combines both components on a common dimensionless basis.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-h2-integrated-mad
#| tbl-cap: "Integrated Model — Calibration Distance Against Anchor Set"

# =============================================================================
# H2. Integrated Model Calibration Summary
# =============================================================================

tbl_h2_integrated_mad <- tibble(
  model       = "Integrated (scoring + risk + continuous adoption)",
  mad_farmers = mad_integrated$mad_farmers,
  mad_land    = mad_integrated$mad_land,
  mad_global  = mad_integrated$mad_global
)

export(
  tbl_h2_integrated_mad,
  here("01_data", "02_processed", "web_resources",
       paste0(file_prefix, "_tbl_h2_integrated_mad.rds"))
)

tbl_h2_integrated_mad |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title    = "Integrated model \u2014 calibration distance",
    subtitle = "Relative mean absolute deviation against the five calibration anchors"
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    model       = "Model",
    mad_farmers = "MAD farmers",
    mad_land    = "MAD land (mz)",
    mad_global  = "MAD global"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(columns = mad_farmers, decimals = 3) |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(mad_land, mad_global), decimals = 3) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.size          = px(11),
    heading.title.font.size  = px(14)
  )
```

## H3. Trajectory Visualization Against Anchors

The integrated model's trajectory is visualised against the five calibration anchors: four empirical points from the New Seed market composition matrix (circles) and one structural point recovered from the population at full coverage (triangle). The four segment trajectories appear as solid lines on a percentage-share basis.

```{r}
#| label: fig-h3-trajectory-vs-anchors
#| fig-cap: "Integrated model trajectory against the calibration anchors"
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6

# =============================================================================
# H3. Integrated Trajectory Plot
# =============================================================================

# Convert trajectory absolute counts to share percentages
traj_integrated_long <- traj_integrated |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    N_total  = N_OPV + N_Low + N_Mid + N_High,
    pct_OPV  = if (N_total > 0) N_OPV  / N_total * 100 else NA_real_,
    pct_Low  = if (N_total > 0) N_Low  / N_total * 100 else NA_real_,
    pct_Mid  = if (N_total > 0) N_Mid  / N_total * 100 else NA_real_,
    pct_High = if (N_total > 0) N_High / N_total * 100 else NA_real_
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(p, pct_OPV, pct_Low, pct_Mid, pct_High) |>
  pivot_longer(-p, names_to = "segment", values_to = "pct") |>
  mutate(segment = recode(segment,
                          pct_OPV = "OPV/Criollo", pct_Low = "Low",
                          pct_Mid = "Mid",         pct_High = "High"))

anchors_long <- anchors_farmers |>
  select(p_anchor, pct_OPV, pct_Low, pct_Mid, pct_High, role) |>
  pivot_longer(c(pct_OPV, pct_Low, pct_Mid, pct_High),
               names_to = "segment", values_to = "pct") |>
  mutate(segment = recode(segment,
                          pct_OPV = "OPV/Criollo", pct_Low = "Low",
                          pct_Mid = "Mid",         pct_High = "High"))

export(
  list(trajectory = traj_integrated_long, anchors = anchors_long),
  here("01_data", "02_processed", "web_resources",
       paste0(file_prefix, "_fig_h3_trajectory_vs_anchors.rds"))
)

ggplot(traj_integrated_long, aes(x = p * 100, y = pct, color = segment)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = anchors_long,
             aes(x = p_anchor * 100, y = pct, color = segment,
                 shape = role),
             size = 3, fill = "white", stroke = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = SEGMENT_COLORS) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Empirical (New Seed)"      = 21,
                                "Structural (population)"  = 24)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Integrated model: cohort composition trajectory",
    subtitle = "Solid lines = integrated model; circles = empirical anchors; triangle = structural anchor",
    x        = "National penetration (%)",
    y        = "Cohort share (%)",
    color    = NULL,
    shape    = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 10, color = ADI_ACCENT),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box      = "vertical"
  )
```

## H4. Consolidate and Export Model Configuration

The consolidated model configuration is assembled into a single nested list containing all parameters required by the scoring engine in script 02_06. The list is exported as a single `.rds` artefact stored alongside the other model artefacts in `01_data/02_processed/models/`.

The configuration object contains six top-level fields:

- **`metadata`**: seed and subsidy suffixes, calibration date, source script identifier.
- **`scoring`**: segment scheme, component weights, scoring heuristic specifications.
- **`risk`**: driver variant, driver coefficients, logistic slope, risk weight, structural loss-driver coefficient.
- **`continuous`**: profile cutoffs, floor values, steepness coefficients.
- **`entry_size`**: entry-size profile cutoffs and coefficients.
- **`calibration`**: MAD farmers, MAD land, MAD global from the integrated evaluation.

```{r}
#| label: h4-consolidate-config

# =============================================================================
# H4. Consolidate Model Configuration
# =============================================================================

# Recover the percentile breakpoint specifications from the best heuristics
# by inspecting the variant labels (stable references back to E2 sweeps)
econ_bp_label  <- best_heuristics$label[
  best_heuristics$component == "score_economic"
]
impr_bp_label  <- best_heuristics$label[
  best_heuristics$component == "score_improvement"
]
scale_bp_label <- best_heuristics$label[
  best_heuristics$component == "score_scale"
]
age_label      <- best_heuristics$label[
  best_heuristics$component == "score_age"
]

# Recover the age-score parameters from the best variant name
age_best_variant <- best_heuristics$variant[
  best_heuristics$component == "score_age"
]
age_best_row <- age_variants_grid |>
  filter(variant_name == age_best_variant)

# Recover percentile breakpoint vectors from the best variants
econ_best_variant  <- best_heuristics$variant[
  best_heuristics$component == "score_economic"
]
impr_best_variant  <- best_heuristics$variant[
  best_heuristics$component == "score_improvement"
]
scale_best_variant <- best_heuristics$variant[
  best_heuristics$component == "score_scale"
]

econ_bp_lookup <- list(
  econ_default   = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75),
  econ_soft      = c(0.20, 0.40, 0.60),
  econ_demanding = c(0.50, 0.70, 0.90)
)

impr_bp_lookup <- list(
  impr_default   = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90),
  impr_soft      = c(0.30, 0.60, 0.80, 0.95),
  impr_demanding = c(0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75)
)

scale_bp_lookup <- list(
  scale_default   = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75),
  scale_soft      = c(0.33, 0.66, 0.90),
  scale_demanding = c(0.50, 0.75, 0.90)
)

# Assemble the model configuration object
model_config <- list(

  metadata = list(
    seed_suffix      = seed_suffix,
    subsidy_suffix   = subsidy_suffix,
    calibration_date = Sys.Date(),
    source_script    = "02_05_determine_likely_adopters_model.qmd"
  ),

  scoring = list(
    segment_scheme        = best_scheme_name,
    segment_points        = best_pts,
    component_weights     = best_weights,
    heuristic_economic    = list(
      variant     = econ_best_variant,
      label       = econ_bp_label,
      breakpoints = econ_bp_lookup[[econ_best_variant]]
    ),
    heuristic_improvement = list(
      variant     = impr_best_variant,
      label       = impr_bp_label,
      breakpoints = impr_bp_lookup[[impr_best_variant]]
    ),
    heuristic_scale       = list(
      variant     = scale_best_variant,
      label       = scale_bp_label,
      breakpoints = scale_bp_lookup[[scale_best_variant]]
    ),
    heuristic_age         = list(
      variant     = age_best_variant,
      label       = age_label,
      peak_center = age_best_row$peak_center,
      peak_width  = age_best_row$peak_width,
      profile     = age_best_row$profile
    )
  ),

  risk = list(
    variant     = best_risk_variant,
    alpha_yield = best_risk_row$alpha_y,
    alpha_ratio = best_risk_row$alpha_r,
    alpha_land  = best_risk_row$alpha_L,
    alpha_loss  = ALPHA_LOSS,
    beta        = best_risk_row$beta,
    w_R         = best_risk_row$w_R,
    loss_bands  = list(
      threshold_minus_500 = 100L,
      threshold_minus_200 =  75L,
      threshold_negative  =  50L,
      otherwise           =   0L
    )
  ),

  continuous = list(
    cut_S_M = best_cuts[["S_M"]],
    cut_M_L = best_cuts[["M_L"]],
    floor_S = best_floors$floor_S,
    floor_M = best_floors$floor_M,
    floor_L = best_floors$floor_L,
    k_S     = best_steep$k_S,
    k_M     = best_steep$k_M,
    k_L     = best_steep$k_L
  ),

  entry_size = list(
    cut_S_M = ENTRY_CUT_S_M,
    cut_M_L = ENTRY_CUT_M_L,
    coef_S  = ENTRY_COEF_S,
    coef_M  = ENTRY_COEF_M,
    coef_L  = ENTRY_COEF_L
  ),

  calibration = list(
    mad_farmers = mad_integrated$mad_farmers,
    mad_land    = mad_integrated$mad_land,
    mad_global  = mad_integrated$mad_global,
    anchor_set  = list(
      farmers = anchors_farmers,
      land    = anchors_land,
      weights = anchor_weights
    )
  )
)

# Export the consolidated configuration alongside the other model artefacts
export(
  model_config,
  here("01_data", "02_processed", "models",
       paste0(file_prefix, "_likely_adopters_model_config.rds"))
)
```

# Notes

## Output Artefact

The determined model configuration is exported to `01_data/02_processed/models/02_05_likely_adopters_model_config.rds`. This artefact is consumed by script 02_06 (Likely Adopters scoring and saturation engine), which applies the calibrated configuration to each of the nine seed-by-subsidy combinations handled by the framework.

The configuration object is a nested list with six top-level fields (`metadata`, `scoring`, `risk`, `continuous`, `entry_size`, `calibration`). The structural parameters are taken as invariant across seed variants and subsidy regimes: the relationships between farmer characteristics and adoption priority are modelled as a function of the joint distribution of farmer attributes. The single calibration run on s22 + sub00 therefore produces the model configuration applied across all nine combinations.

## Reproducibility

All stochastic operations in this script (Boruta feature selection in Phase C, and the parallel sweeps in Phases F and G) are seeded with `set.seed(789)` immediately before invocation, in line with the ADI reproducibility convention. The MIRAI daemon pool used for the risk-aversion and continuous-adoption sweeps disables BLAS multithreading inside each daemon via `RhpcBLASctl::blas_set_num_threads(1)`, removing thread-scheduling variability in the matrix operations performed by `Hmisc::wtd.quantile()`.

## Calibration Anchors

The five anchor points combine four empirical observations from the New Seed market composition matrix at production coverage levels 5%, 10%, 20%, 30%, and one structural anchor at full coverage recovered from the segmented dataset. The four New Seed anchors carry weight `w_p = 1.0`; the structural anchor carries auxiliary weight `w_p = 0.5`. The MAD evaluation operates on relative deviations: each cell error is normalised by the corresponding anchor value plus a small offset, so that all anchor cells contribute proportionally regardless of their absolute magnitude.

## Theoretical Framework

The adoption decomposition by behavioural profile (S, M, L) and by segment (OPV/Criollo, Low, Mid, High) reflects two complementary stratifications established in the agricultural-innovation literature. Aggregate adoption of agricultural innovations has been modelled canonically with sigmoidal curves since Griliches (1957); the survey by Sunding & Zilberman (2001) confirms that the logistic sigmoid is the dominant functional form for aggregate penetration of agricultural technologies. The decomposition by farmer category follows Rogers (2003), adapted to economic-agronomic rather than attitudinal criteria. For the QPM-specific case, the literature on adoption in Sub-Saharan Africa (Kostandini, La Rovere & Abdoulaye, 2013; Beyene, Kassie, Shiferaw & Marenya, 2017) supports the use of sigmoidal curves with subgroup decomposition. The risk-aversion penalty follows the smallholder-adoption literature on land allocation under uncertainty (Smale, Just & Leathers, 1994) and on risk perception in technology adoption (Liu et al., 2023).

## Terminology

The segment label `OPV/Criollo` identifies farmers planting open-pollinated or
saved seed. Published outputs refer to this group as **non-hybrid**; the
two terms denote the same segment.
